text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way!? M-My skin... is breaking 
out!?"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... As a proud knight... I should 
always keep my face dignified and 
composed...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Don't look at me, mirror 
reflection! Don't look at this disgrace 
unbecoming of a knight...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal's skin is acting up a bit, and 
she seems troubled by it..."
